# Public test profile

This directory contains fictional values for testing PDF Unlocker without
entering personal information.

- profile.yml: synthetic profile fixture
- rule00000.yml: reserved public test rule
- All values are synthetic placeholders.
- Never add real personal, identity, banking, or contact information.
- Rule ID 00000 is reserved for this fixture.
- Normal rules begin at 00001.
- Disable rule 00000 after the test phase is complete.

This YAML fixture is portable test data, not an installed runtime profile.
Automatic profile import/seed support must be implemented and tested separately.
